propositions: The test oracle _bounded_bank_gaps measures executed filesystem-tool calls but the policy enforcement boundary counts evidence RESPONSES, decoupling units after commit e1352535ace
Post-dd41, a batching model executes ~11 reads in <=2 evidence responses, never reaching the 3-response fallback, causing all five verdicts to bank at executed-call counter 11
The oracle must be re-denominated from executed calls to evidence responses (distinct run_steps) while preserving the 0707 safety intent of incremental banking with gaps <= 3
Steered calls returning COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE must not be counted in response tallies; only distinct run_steps at which evidence tools actually execute are recorded
Unit regression tests must verify the re-scoped oracle rejects zero-bank exhaustion and first banks after >3 evidence responses, while accepting the dd41-intended batched shape
